newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofgas head says regulatory review needed.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofgas head says regulatory review needed.

text.p: Britain's gas industry regulator Clare Spottiswoode said on Monday that the new Labour government's planned review of regulation was needed and welcome.
"I welcome the review...there is a need to clarify the respective roles, responsibilities and acountability of regulators and government," she told a conference here.
Spottiswoode, who is head of Ofgas, added that there had already been "very substantial change within the regulated industries...and by the year 2000 they will be different again."

The Trade and Industry Secretary Margaret Beckett announced earlier on Monday to the conference that there would be an inter-departmental review of regulation covering gas, water, electricity and telecommunications as well as transport.
"This review will provide a timely and valuable opportunity to examine and underline the distinctions" between government and regulatory roles, Spottiswoode added.
